rv.q: Just because Gulman can go long, though, does not always mean that Grandiloquent makes the best use of that time.
Gulman magnificently and selflessly unearths every opportunity for humor.
Gulman masterfully weaves his insecurities and highly evolved sense of humor into a bravura performance that’s as wise as it is hysterical.
Gulman provides a hilariously deadpan account of his young years that proves as poignant as it is funny.
Grandiloquent sets the stage for his new chapter as a theatre artist.
Gulman's gentle, brainy style of humor will find a receptive audience

cn.t: Gary Gulman's Off-Broadway debut earns praise for its whip-smart wordplay and surprising emotional depth, as the comedian mines his troubled childhood with exceptional humor and heartfelt vulnerability that resonates with audiences.
